name: expressive-design
description: Designs and builds distinctive, memorable web pages from the subject's own evidence: a claim ledger, one thesis object carrying the identity, a still composition judged with motion off, parallel design directions, a motion contract per effect, a sourced Baseline and WCAG 2.2 floor, and a dependency-free source scanner for reduced-motion, zoom, focus, layout-shift, template-look and fake-proof failures.
